question: Sarbpreet Singh is the author of which of the following books?

options.text: 40 years with Abdul Kalam - Untold Stories
Night of the Restless Spirits: Stories from 1984

solution:
The correct answer is __**Night of the Restless Spirits: Stories from 1984.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarbpreet Singh**__

 __
 
• **Sarbpreet Singh is a writer, Podcaster and Commentator.**
 
• He is also the author of the critically acclaimed Night of the Restless Spirits and the bestselling The Camel Merchant of Philadelphia, and the writer-narrator of the Story of The Sikh's podcast which has listeners in over ninety countries.
 
 
 
• **Night of the Restless Spirits: Stories from 1984**__
 __
 
• These are many other stories from this heart-rending collection that evokes the horrors and uncertainties of 1984, through the tales of ordinary people caught in something bigger than themselves.
 
• **The author Sarbpreet Singh recounts the Sikh massacre of 1984 in this book.**
 
• The book is a fictionalized version of real happenings comprising just eight Chapters.
 
• **It shows the events of 1984 through the prism of many lives & impact on Sikhs**.
 
• The book is published by Penguin Publication.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **40 Years with Abdul Kalam-Untold Stories**__ 

 
 
• **The Vice President of India, M Venkaiah Naidu has released the book titled "40 Years with Abdul Kalam-Untold Stories", a book on the life of the former President of India Dr APJ Abdul Kalam**.
 
• **The book was authored by DR A.Sivathanu Pillai. The book is published by Pentagon Press LLP and the foreword was written by Pranab Mukherjee, former president of India.**
 
• The book provided a first-Hand account of the life of Dr APJ Abdul Kalam, who was described as the epitome of simplicity, honesty, and wisdom.
 
• Dr. Kalam strengthened the Defence sector of India and contributed to the development of India's space capabilities.
 
• The book discusses his life events including the events at ISRO, DRDO, and BrahMos and his interaction with power corridors.
